name: Roshutsu Choukyou Doukoukai
source:
One day, Keiichi catch his childhood friend Jun masturbating.
After that, she somehow end up asking him teaching her about sex.
Soon, 2 others girls end up joining the teaching.

Master? Lover? How will theirs relationships turn out after that?
